name: Damanganga

source.name: Near Ambegaon, Dindori taluka, Sahyadri hills

did_you_know: The river's two headwater tributaries, the Daman and the Vag, run separately before merging at Matunji to form the Damanganga proper.
It supplies the industrial towns of Vapi, Dadra and Silvassa before the town of Daman straddles both banks of its estuary.
It is the source basin proposed for the Damanganga-Pinjal river-linking project, intended to divert surplus monsoon flow toward the Mumbai region — a plan approved in principle but not implemented.
